verified_behavior: Manual captures preserve the submitted description and source fields while storing detected skill taxonomy as description mentions.
Only verified, approved, sourced skill facts with confidence at least 80 support a match; pending facts do not count.
A multiword approved fact can support its detected taxonomy skill without changing the original career fact.
Supported skill aliases normalize before comparison and produce a canonical explanation label.
Description-only job skill mentions are labeled UNKNOWN; explicit structured required and preferred lists retain their declared strength.
Preferred skill evidence has half the score weight of required skill evidence; nice-to-have and unknown mentions use lower weights.
Match explanations persist with canonical jobs and reload through the existing profile-scoped job read model.
The browser submits a durable rescore request after manual capture when a profile is selected; a failed or unavailable rescore does not misreport or hide the already-saved job.
Queued rescore work uses the current profile version at execution so an approval revocation before the worker starts cannot publish a match based on stale approvals.

findings: Queue failure after durable capture could look like total failure; browser now reports capture saved and permits rescore retry.
Queued rescore pinned an older profile version; worker now recalculates against current approved facts.
Detected skill aliases could miss an approved canonical fact; scoring now normalizes and deduplicates aliases.
Planning head pointer described a superseded candidate; exact pending candidate fields will be omitted until final receipt can be recorded without a self-referential commit.

limitations: This is evidence-coverage ranking, not a qualification assessment or the full MJ-REQ-112..119 acceptance.
Salary, location, experience, education, certifications, employment type, saved-filter controls, and broader search ranking are not implemented by this slice.
No new public-source adapter or live network read is claimed by this evidence; bounded public Greenhouse reads have separate hosted evidence in PR #508.
Product AI remains optional and unavailable in this slice; no provider call or private data transmission occurred.
The fixes have local targeted tests; fresh independent review and exact-head GitHub push/pull_request checks with runtime artifacts remain pending.
